items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
items.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.
